items.title: Hisense listed by WhiteArmor ($5M demand)
items.summary: WhiteArmor posted Hisense to its leak site on Oct 26 claiming 19 GB stolen and a $5M demand with a ~28-day countdown; the claim is unverified.

items.title: Santiam Hospital & Clinics claimed by Anubis
items.summary: The Anubis group listed Oregon-based Santiam Hospital & Clinics as a victim on Oct 28.

items.title: Morrison Foerster listed by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: SilentRansomGroup, a data-extortion crew known for targeting law firms, listed Morrison Foerster on Oct 28; the group's listings have included unverified claims.

items.title: October leak-site claims up ~26% to 1,127
items.summary: Leak sites posted 1,127 victims in October vs 896 in September, with N0n, Qilin and The Gentlemen accounting for over 40% of listings.

items.title: October 2026 attack & breach roundup
items.summary: Monthly roundup of the biggest ransomware attacks and breaches disclosed during October 2026.

ransomware.note: Only two days into November — no November-dated victims indexed yet; items are from the last week of October. Leak-site posts are attacker claims, not confirmed incidents.

items.title: Archive of Our Own offline after security breach
items.summary: AO3 went down Oct 29 in what was first called maintenance; operators later disclosed a security breach and expect at least two weeks offline.

items.title: Cloudflare outage, Twilio degraded (Oct 30)
items.summary: A status-aggregator snapshot late on Oct 30 showed Cloudflare in outage and Twilio degraded while AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and GitHub reported operational.

items.title: Revolut transfer and sign-in disruptions
items.summary: Revolut logged several short incidents on Oct 30, including ~15 minutes of downtime and user reports of failed transfers and logins.

items.title: Brief US connectivity drop in Texas and Iowa
items.summary: IODA flagged a one-minute critical connectivity drop around 04:11 UTC on Oct 30 in Texas and Iowa, with no sign of a broader outage.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud incident reported in the last week; findings come from third-party status trackers, so confirm against provider status pages.

items.title: Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added a Cisco ASA/FTD denial-of-service flaw to KEV on Oct 29 after active exploitation was confirmed.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain in KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-104935, an auth-bypass and RCE chain that Volexity found exploited against patched VPN appliances, was added to KEV; a related Ivanti fix deadline falls today (Nov 2).

items.title: Two PHP flaws added to KEV (Oct 26)
items.summary: CISA added two exploited PHP vulnerabilities on Oct 26, part of the fastest pace of KEV additions since 2022.

items.title: Six KEV additions incl. Plex and Siemens
items.summary: On Oct 20, CISA added six exploited flaws covering Plex Media Server, a SiteGuard command injection and a Siemens issue.

items.title: AO3 user-data exposure not ruled out
items.summary: AO3 operators say no data was deleted in the Oct 29 breach but they cannot yet rule out theft of users' personal data.

items.title: October KEV pace: 36 additions
items.summary: One analysis counted 36 KEV additions in October against 43 in September, the highest sustained rate since 2022; its tally may differ from CISA's.

items.title: M 6.4 southeast of Easter Island
items.summary: A magnitude 6.4 quake struck a remote area southeast of Easter Island on Oct 29; USGS alert level green with no tsunami.

items.title: Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan and southern Japan
items.summary: Champi crossed Taiwan and Japan's southern islands Oct 22–24, cutting power to about 288,000 homes and injuring 527.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab strikes Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Arnab killed three people and damaged homes and farmland in eastern India, AP reported Oct 27.

items.title: Four Corners flash flooding and outages
items.summary: Flooding Oct 22–24 forced water rescues and left hundreds without power across the US Southwest, and the NWS warned of further flash flooding.

items.title: Nigeria floods: 245 dead, 215,000 displaced
items.summary: Seasonal flooding across 28 Nigerian states had killed 245 and displaced nearly 215,000 as of Oct 20, with further risk expected.

physical.note: No November events indexed yet; items cover the final week of October.
